title: PBMC Isolation and Cryopreservation
author: Marloes Van Splunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.87phzmn

steps.title: Prepare Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples in tubes containing sodium heparinate and organize donors from low (1) to high (31) number, dividing them into 2 batches.

steps.title: Prepare Leucosep Tubes
steps.instruction: Fill two Leucosep® tubes per donor with 15 mL of Ficoll plaque separation medium at room temperature (RT).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 1000 x g at RT to move the medium below the porous barrier.

steps.title: Add PBS and Blood
steps.instruction: Add 9 mL of PBS at RT to the Leucosep tubes and add anticoagulated blood at a 2:1 blood:PBS dilution.

substeps.instruction: Pour 2 blood tubes per donor into the correct Leucosep tubes (total volume approximately 30 mL, consisting of 2 blood tubes of 8-10 mL each plus 9 mL PBS).

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 minutes at 1000 x g at RT using a swinging bucket rotor.

substeps.instruction: Switch off centrifuge brakes (set deceleration = 1, acceleration = 3).
Harvest the enriched cell fraction (PBMCs) from the interphase using a sterile 1 mL pipette.
Collect PBMCs into a correctly labelled 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Wash PBMCs
steps.instruction: Wash the PBMCs three times to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add RPMI1640 up to 35 mL and centrifuge for 7 minutes at 250 x g.
Pour supernatant into a waste bottle and resuspend the pellet by flicking the tube.
Repeat the wash step twice more.
After the final wash, resuspend the cell pellet up to a total volume of 10 mL with RPMI1640.

steps.title: Count and Prepare for Use
steps.instruction: Resuspend the PBMCs in 2 mL of RPMI-1640 medium and count the cells (refer to NOBLE protocol) before proceeding to staining, cell culture, or cryopreservation.

steps.title: Prepare Freezing Media and Vials
steps.instruction: Prepare labelled cryovials (name, date, concentration 5-10x10^6 cells/ml, and content) and freezing media stored at 4ºC.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Medium B: 20% DMSO and 80% FCS (to achieve final concentrations of 10% DMSO and 90% FCS).

steps.title: Resuspend Cells for Freezing
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell suspension for cryopreservation after the third wash (or perform one additional wash at 7 minutes, 250 x g).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend PBMCs in ice-cold Medium A (100% FCS) at a concentration of 10x10^6 PBMCs per 1 mL in a 15 mL tube for all donors in one batch.
Add an equal volume (mL) of ice-cold Medium B (20% DMSO & 80% FCS) to the tube while gently mixing by shaking.

steps.title: Aliquot and Freeze Cells
steps.instruction: Divide the cell suspension into cryovials and initiate the freezing process.

substeps.instruction: Divide 1 mL of cell suspension over a maximum of 4 correctly labelled cryovials; record the number of vials filled.
Repeat for all donors in the batch.
Place cryovials in a white box, surround with paper towels, and place inside a large Styrofoam box with a lid.
Place the box in a -80 ºC freezer for 8-12 hours (overnight).
Transfer cells to liquid nitrogen or -160 ºC storage.
